question: How is the victim situated among yoginis designated within the Kula tradition?
premises: The victim is placed in the midst of the yogini group.
He is identified as the animal victim.
This designation is declared in the Kula.
inference: In the Kula, the one placed amid the yogini group is called the animal victim.
plain_english: In the Kula, he who is situated in the middle of the group of yoginis is called the animal victim.
